downloadMedia.description: Download each image/video into this run's Apify key-value store and return permanent public URLs. The original Snapchat CDN URL stays in a matching *Original field. Capped at 200 files and 50 MB per file per run; failures keep the direct URL. Costs extra storage and bandwidth; off by default because Snapchat CDN links work for immediate downloads.
downloadMedia.title: Store Durable Media Copies

maxHighlightsPerUser.description: How many of a profile's saved highlight albums to read, in the order Snapchat renders them. 0 uses every highlight on the page.
maxHighlightsPerUser.title: Max Highlights Per Profile

maxItems.description: Hard cap on snap records saved in the run across all targets. The actor stops cleanly when it reaches this number.
maxItems.title: Max Records

maxSnapsPerUser.description: Maximum snaps to save per profile, highlight or story-snap target. Supports large highlight albums up to the clip length shown by Snapchat.
maxSnapsPerUser.title: Max Snaps Per Target

mode.description: What to scrape. profiles = look up usernames or profile URLs and collect their highlights and active story. urls = process pasted profile, highlight or active-story snap links, including highlights that are not on the rendered profile page.
mode.title: Mode

postedAfter.description: Only keep snaps posted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO 8601). Saved highlights can stay live for years, so set this to your last run date when you only want new snaps. Leave empty for everything.
postedAfter.title: Posted After

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy override. Public Snapchat profiles work without a proxy.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

sources.description: Which story surfaces to collect in profiles mode. curatedHighlights = saved highlight albums. activeStory = the currently public 24-hour story. Highlight-link mode always returns the linked highlight.
sources.title: Story Sources

startUrls.description: (mode=urls) Paste profile links, highlight links (https://www.snapchat.com/@user/highlight/<id>) or active-story snap links (https://www.snapchat.com/@user/<snapId>). Each link is resolved to exactly the content it names.
startUrls.title: Profile, Highlight or Story Links

usernames.description: (mode=profiles) One or more Snapchat usernames or profile URLs. Accepts bare username (brentrivera), @-prefixed (@brentrivera), add URL (https://www.snapchat.com/add/brentrivera) and profile URL (https://www.snapchat.com/@brentrivera).
usernames.title: Usernames or Profile URLs
